mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced discount rates on equity cash flows.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.0%) signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 8.0%, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) signals housing sector contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 700 and RSAFS < 400000, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.0% monthly), the economy is in expansion phase, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO growth rate > 1.0%, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A higher employment level (PAYEMS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to stronger consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The correlation between PAYEMS and 5-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL > 230.0) signals inflationary pressure that may lead to monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 230.0, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) and high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL > 230.0) signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 230.0, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A low housing starts level (HOUST < 700) signals housing sector contraction, acting as a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 700, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in more than 40% of cases.
